text: Hello Lieutenant. Emilio Sanude was looking for you.
He wanted you to go to headquarters.
It may have something to do with the fleet that just returned from the New World.
Hello Lieutenant. How are you today?
Emilio Sanude was looking for you.
He walked away in that direction, so he must be at headquarters, to the right of the palace.
Do you think Commander Ezequiel will really allow us to seek out the Francos?
Well... I don't know.
Hey there, friend, business is good as usual, eh?
Why hello Emilio, it's been a long time since I last saw you.
Two glasses of wine, please.
Emilio, it just doesn't make sense. I just can't believe my brother would be lost in a storm.
I agree.
And I can't believe that a Spanish fleet would be attacked.
It could be Caribbean pirates that attacked the fleet. They'll regret it! As long as I'm in the Navy, they'll never rest.
What are you going to do now?
I'm a Navy officer, $n. I'll do some investigating whenever I stop at a port, and eventually I'll find out what happened to them.
Actually, those men are talking about that very thing, right now.
Hey, Giovanni, have ye heard the latest gossip?
Aye, a Royal Naval fleet disappeared in the Caribbean Sea.
There's whispers that Black Beard did it.
Aye, but I hear 'tis only a yarn.
One of me mates says some Portuguese salts are involved.
He says that they set fire to the fleet when it was resupplying in Santo Domingo.
Rumor has it that the attacking ship was flying a flag with the red cross of the Malta Knights.
What? That's the flag of Duke Franco's private battle fleet!
Arrrgh, ye never can trust those Portuguese.
Excuse me, but could you repeat that?
Who in the blazes are ye?
I'm a lieutenant in the Royal Navy. Are you sure that what you just said is true?
Well, I don't know for certain, but the rumor is spreading like wildfire among me men.
Come on Emilio, I want to tell Commander Ezequiel about this.
And?
And I will request permission to seek out and destroy the Francos.
Commander, I have a request.
What is it, Lieutenant?
I know who is responsible for the attack on my brother's fleet.
Oh really?
It's Duke Franco of Portugal.
Please give me a battleship and soldiers to avenge Michael and Hernan.
Please, Commander, I'm begging you! I must have my revenge!
Lieutenant $s, do you have any idea what you're saying?
W, Well...
I don't know where you heard that rumor, but one thing is clear:
Attacking the Francos will cause a full-fledged war between Spain and Portugal.
Forget your absurd ideas of revenge. Return to your duties, at once.
$n, don't be so down.
Here, this is Commodore Michael's saber. Take this with you.

|Lieutenant Emilio Sanude|
$n, I was looking for you. Commander Ezequiel needs to talk to you.
The Commander? Is it about my missing brother?
Well... I think you should hear it from the Commander.
Lieutenant $n $s, reporting for duty, sir.

|Commander Ezequiel|
Thank you for coming. At ease.
Well, I have some news about your brother, Michael.
We lost contact with his fleet on April 10, 1522, off the coast of Santo Domingo.
My brother... I just can't believe it. He's one of the best sailors in the navy.
Besides, he has Hernan in his fleet.
Yes, Michael was a capable man. His first mate, your fiance Hernan, was also a brave man.
But we got a report this morning from a fleet we sent to investigate the matter.
All they found were the remains of a shipwreck. The entire fleet was terribly damaged, and there was no one on board.
The cause of the destruction is unknown. It could have been a storm, or perhaps someone attacked them...
But this flag was found on the wreck... It's Michael's.
I'm sorry to be the one to tell you this, but I'm afraid he didn't make it.
I... He didn't... but...
I understand your grief, but I'm sure he would want you to be brave at a time like this.
Lieutenant Sanude, please escort Lieutenant $s safely to her quarters.
Yes, sir.
I'm so sorry, $n. It's all so sudden... he was my commanding officer as well as my best friend. I vow to find out what happened.
Let's go to the pub. I'll buy you a glass of wine.
Hey, what did Commander Ezequiel say?
... well...
Sir, don't talk about Commodore Michael now.
Oh... I'm sorry.
You should go to headquarters right now. It's to the right of the palace.
Lieutenant $s, have you heard any news about your missing brother?
Don't worry. I'm sure a strong mate like Michael is doing just fine.
Emilio was here looking for you. He wants you to go to headquarters.
A fleet has just returned from the New World, so maybe he wanted to talk to you about that. He looked pretty serious - something important must have happened.
Thanks for the information. I'll get right over to headquarters.
Hey Lieutenant $s, have you got any information about your missing brother?
...well...
Sir, don't mention Commodore Michael now, please.
I see. Sorry.
Sorry Lieutenant $s, but we are closing now.
Lieutenant $n, have you seen Commander Ezequiel yet? Did he say anything about your brother?
...well...
Sir, don't mention Commodore Michael now, please.
Oh... I'm sorry.
You should go to headquarters as soon as possible! It's to the right of the palace.
Ah, Lieutenant $s. Perfect timing. A fleet has just returned from a trip to the New World.
Commander Ezequiel wants to talk to you about it. Your presence is requested at headquarters, to the right of the palace.
Hey, Lieutenant $s, I heard a fleet just came back from an investigation in the New World. Any news on your brother?
...well...
Sir, please don't talk about Commodore Michael right now.
Oh... Sorry.
Hey, Lieutenant $s, I heard gossip from a merchant fleet on the Ionian route.
It seems it was a Portuguese who attacked that Spanish fleet.
Hello, Lieutenant $s.
Lieutenant Sanude was looking for you.
He must be at headquarters, next to the palace.
Hello, Lieutenant $s. Have you heard any news about your brother, Commodore Michael?
Lieutenant Sanude was looking for you.
He went to headquarters, next to the palace.
Let's go to the pub. Maybe we'll hear more about what happened.
$n, are you OK? I should take you home.
I'm OK. But I just can't figure out what could have happened to the two of them.
Hey, why don't we go to the pub? Maybe we can get some more information.
Hi Lieutenant! Sorry, but we're closed today.
$n, there is nothing we can do.
I won't give up. I can't give up!
Calm down. Let's go to the pub and talk things over.
Emilio, I may have to betray...
Betray what?
Never mind. Let's go to the harbor.
So, $n, what are you going to do now?
I'm going to quit the Navy.
What?!
As long as I'm in the Navy, I can't avenge the loss of my brother, or my fiance.
But the Francos are powerful. It's impossible for a mere civilian to defeat the Duke of Portugal!
It's so easy to give up now, isn't it?
Who are you?
Nobody important. But I don't like your attitude.
Give up without trying? Run away because you can't win? Is that how honorable Spanish Naval officers behave?
Who IS this guy? $n, let's get out of here. He's just another crazy drunk.
Wait, Emilio. I've finally made up my mind.
What? What did you decide?
Emilio, I need your help.
I'll do whatever I can.
Then come with me to the harbor.
Emilio, I need your help.
I'll do anything I can, $n.
Then come with me to the harbor.
What are you going to do?
Any ship will do. If only I had a ship...
Wait. Let's go to the pub and talk things over.
What are you planning on doing?
I'm going to take a ship from the Spanish Navy.
Are you crazy?!
No, not at all. I just remembered, you have command of a ship - the ship carrying gold from the New World.
But that's treason! Commander Ezequiel will wring my neck, have me fired!
Afraid of a little danger, Lieutenant?
$n, what are you doing?
Don't move, or I'll shoot.
I don't want to hurt you. I just need a hostage, right now.
I'll drop you off at a neutral port. Until then please cooperate with me, Emilio!
I'm really sorry to get you involved, but I have no other choice.
Alright, $n.
What?
I'll join your mission. But you'll have to command the ship.
The ringleader of a treacherous act has no hope if he, or she, gets caught. But an accomplice may be able to get away with just a simple prison sentence.
That's more like it! Now, let's talk strategy.
Well, you're the commodore. Name your flagship.
Hmm... what do you think of 'Rebel?'
Rebel, huh? Why, I can't think of a more suitable name for the flagship of a lady pirate.
Then, let's get our rebellion started!
Wait a minute. There must be some gold bars left on this ship.
We should sell the gold bars and get some spending money first.
That's a good plan. I'll have to remember to sell them when we get a chance.
Rebel
$n, I think what Commander Ezequiel says makes sense.
Then what should I do?
I can't tell you to give up, but...
$n, there is nothing you can do.
I won't give up.
Take it easy. Let's talk about it over a glass of wine.
$n, what are you thinking about?
I want power... the power to defeat the Francos.
The power...
Emilio, I want you to help me.
Of course, $n. I'll do whatever I can.
Then come with me to the harbor.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. I think you'll really regret going in there.
Commodore $n, I heard a bad rumor in the harbor.
What?
Commander Ezequiel has been issued an official order from the King to arrest you.
I see. That isn't good news.
What shall we do?
If you're asking me to surrender, my answer is NO.
Then will you fight against your own country?
You can leave me now if you wish. I don't intend to force you to commit treason.
No, once an officer pledges his loyalty, it's for good.
Now, that's the spirit.
Commodore, this is the Franco's residence. They'll have your neck if you enter.
May I help you?
No. No, thank you.
It seems Commander Ezequiel himself is out at sea.
Splendid! The Spanish Fleet is all out in the bay.
So this is just a preliminary skirmish.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. I doubt you'd make it back alive if you went in there.
Commodore, another fleet is approaching. That's...
It's Commander Ezequiel's flag ship, the Santa Cruz! And look - they're signaling a message to us by flag...
It says 'Your previous battle was a brave yet vain attempt. Surrender now, and you may get a special pardon.'
'But if you resist, there will be no future, glory, or life for rebels.'
Rebels...
Hard to starboard! Commodore, fleeing is the only way out of here!
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. I don't think we should be hanging out around here.
We'll have a battle with the Spanish Fleet again.
I can't give in until I avenge the loss of both my brother Michael and fiance Hernan.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. You'll be in hot water if you enter.
Commodore, we're surrounded by the enemy fleet. We can't escape!
This may be the last battle for us...
Emilio, I regret that I got you involved in my personal grudge.
That's OK. It was my choice to join you. I'll accompany you till the very end.
Attention crew, prepare to assault the enemy.
Commodore, something is strange about the way the enemy is moving. It seems as if they're retreating...
There's a fire in the enemy's battle line. It looks like a fire was set while they were in close formation!
They're fleeing!
What a stroke of luck! We're saved! Wait, what is that, drifting over there?
It's a Spanish officer! He's clinging to a piece of driftwood.
Pull him up on deck.
Whew, thanks for saving me.
You are now our prisoner. State your name and rank.
Huh, don't be so pretentious, pirates! My name is Andreas Paella. I'm a lieutenant in the Spanish Navy.
You should also know that I am the one who saved you. I set that fire.
That's an obvious lie. Why would a stranger save us?
Oh, I see you don't have too much of a memory. But then you've probably met a hundred crazy drunks at the pub.
Oh, you're the crazy drunk from the pub!
You must be wondering why I saved you. Well, Miss Lady Pirate, I was a school buddy of your fiance, Hernan Obregon.
Even though he was from a noble family, he was still a good guy. He was very kind to people like me who grew up in poverty.
That's why I decided to save you. And I'd like to join your mission, too.
So let me work for you, Commodore. I'm quite useful, you know.
What should we do?
Well, welcome aboard, mate.
Thank you, Commodore! We're going to make a great team!
Don't get me wrong. You might be useful to me, but I don't completely trust you yet.
If you give me the slightest reason to suspect you of betrayal, it's all over for you.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Why would you want to go in there?
May I help you?
No. No, thank you.
I heard an interesting rumor, Commodore.
What is it? About Commander Ezequiel again?
No. It's about our enemy.
Duke Franco disowned his son, Joao Franco, who is now traveling the high seas.
If that's true, then we're in luck.
If Joao is in Lisbon, we can't approach him. But if he's out on the sea, we'll have plenty of opportunities to attack.
Andreas Paella!
Uh, yes, Commodore?
I, did you hear that, I will destroy the Francos. Try to remember that. No one is to interfere with my revenge.
I understand, Commodore.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Let's break in and take the scoundrels.
Don't be a fool. If we cause trouble here, the whole town will be after us.
May I help you?
No. No, thank you.
Hello there. Have you, by any chance, seen a sailor named Joao?
No, I haven't.
You're not lying, are you?
Ouch! Why would I lie to you?!
Stop that, Andreas. We'll be leaving now. Sorry to bother you.
Have you seen a guy named Joao Franco?
No, I haven't.
OK. Thank you.
Commodore, this is the residence of the evil Francos. Let's break in and get 'em!
Don't be a fool. If you cause any trouble, the whole town will be hunting us.
May I help you?
No. No, thank you.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. I think we should steer clear of this house.
Commodore, we still haven't found that Joao kid.
It's like looking for a needle in a haystack.
I know he's out there, somewhere. We have to find him. And there'll be no rest for me until I do.
Commodore, this is Franco's residence. We're goners for sure if we enter.
Commodore, I heard an interesting piece of information.
Is it about Duke Franco or Commander Ezequiel?
Duke Franco. I've heard that the Prince of Portugal is missing right now.
Some people say Duke Franco may be involved.
Oh really? How so?
Well, they say Duke Franco plotted to eliminate the Prince so his son Joao could take the throne.
If that rumor is true then Duke Franco is a real villain.
He's worse than we pirates!
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Breaking in would cause big trouble.
Look, Commodore! Those people are all running somewhere.
It must be a fight or something.
Looks like they went into the shipyard.
Hey! Looks like there's a big fight over there!
Those two people are being attacked by that huge mob of pirates!
Andreas! Emilio! Let's save them!
Hmph, you're pretty tough. Hey, you guys, it's time for you to take care of the kid!
Not if I have anything to say about it!
Who in the blazes are you?
A pirate, like yourself. But not so vile as the likes of you, to attack two people with so many men.
A lady pirate?! Ha, you're that Spanish traitor, aren't you!
No one has survived a duel with me. On guard!
Blast! You'll regret this!
Pirates have such a limited vocabulary. Can't they ever say something original?
Thank you very much. You saved my life.
Don't mention it. You're Portuguese, aren't you?
I am Joao Franco. As a token of my thanks, I'll play a song on my lute for you.
... What irony... I saved the life of a Franco.
What's the matter?
I am the sister of Commodore Michael $s of Spain. You are responsible for his loss.
Prepare yourself for my fury!
W, Wait! I don't understand! Why do you want to fight me?
No more stalling. Pick up your sword!
Commodore, just a moment. I heard something outside.
Pirate $n, I know you're in there. You're under arrest by orders of the King of Spain, Carlos I.
Throw down your weapons and surrender!
Ugh, I could almost... Listen kid, you were lucky this time, but next time we meet, revenge will be mine!
Sorry, but we're closed today. There was a big fight here and we have to clean up.
Did you hear a scream?
Yes, I did. I think it came from the shipyard.
Let's check it out.
Commodore, this is the harbor, not the shipyard.
Look at the fleet anchored there, Commodore!
The flag of the main mast has the red cross of the Malta Knights.
Someone is coming toward us.
You know, Rocco, you're a really strong guy.
Excuse me, are you the owner of that ship?
Why yes. I am Joao Franco, Commodore of the fleet.
Fr, Franco!
I am the sister of Commodore Michael $s of Spain. You are responsible for his loss. Now I will take my revenge!
Wait! I don't understand!
Pick up your sword! On guard!
Commodore, just a moment. I heard something outside.
$n, I know you're in there. You're under arrest by orders of the King of Spain, Carlos I. Come out with your hands up!
Curses! Listen kid, luck was on your side this time, but watch out! I will get my revenge!
Did you hear a scream?
Yes, I did. I think it came from the shipyard.
Let's check it out.
I thought we were going to the shipyard.
Commodore, we didn't go to the shipyard, after all.
Commodore, what do you think of sneaking into this house and making a surprise attack?
That doesn't sound fair.
May I help you?
No. No, thank you. No surprise attack, of course. Excuse us.
Hummm, they're a suspicious lot...
Commodore, I found someone who knows where Joao is.
Are you sure? You know, your information isn't always reliable.
Shut up! You're the one who's useless!
That does it, I've had enough of your insults. Let's settle this with our fists. C'mon!
Stop quarreling!
Andreas, who said he knows of Joao's whereabouts?
This scurvy pirate, called Bret Perot. He insists on speaking to you personally, Commodore. He's at the pub.
OK, I'll talk to him.
Commodore, Perot is waiting for you. Let's hurry to the pub.
Hey, Perot, the Commodore is here to see you.
You'd better not give us false information, buster, you'll pay for it, you hear?
You'll wake up with a big headache, you got that?
OK, I understand! Andreas, I wouldn't lie to you.
Two days ago, I ran into a Portuguese fleet just outside this port.
Our fleet was disguised as a Portuguese merchant fleet.
I planned to attack them suddenly, once they'd let down their guard.
Skip the irrelevant stuff. Just get to the point!
OK, OK! Just be patient. I gathered my courage and started talking with the fleet, asking where they were going.
The sailor who responded was an old man named Rocco, Joao's first mate.
He told me they were heading toward $r17.
Thank you, but your story was too long!
Are you sure about this?
You're too suspicious! I swear to you, on my ship, that it's true.
Emilio, Andreas, let's go. Thank you, Perot.
Commodore, Perot is waiting for you. Let's hurry to the pub.
Oh, hello there. I thought I recognized you. Aren't you friends with Sir Joao?
Hi Marco! I was in the area, so I thought I'd stop by and say hello.
Emilio, what are you thinking? You want to make friends with the Francos?
Well, he was quite pleasant.
I can't believe how nice he's being to us! This must be one of those rare hidden events.
Are you a friend of Sir Joao?
Well, we're not really friends yet.
I see. Do you have any news about him?
Yes, he's heading toward $r17.
Thank you very much for telling me that. This gold is a token of my gratitude.
You mean you'd really like to give me 1000 gold pieces? Well, then, thank you. I appreciate it.
Commodore, look at this. I got a reward.
I'm dumbfounded. This is a strange turn of events.
Hey, Waiter! Have you seen a sailor named Joao?
No, I haven't.
You're not lying to me, are you?
Ouch! Why should I lie to you!?
Stop that, Andreas!
This guy is lying. I know it!
Let's go. Sorry to bother you.
Commodore, let's ask about Joao at the pub, first.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Let's get out of here.
Next time I see Bret Perot, he'll pay for this.
Commodore, maybe Joao's fleet hasn't arrived here yet.
Or he hasn't visited the pub yet.
OK. Let's wait here a while.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Let's forget about the rest of the Francos and concentrate on Joao.
Hey, Bartender. Are you sure you haven't seen Joao?
Oh no, not you again.
Why are you so nervous, huh?
Ouch... OK, I'll tell you. Quit it!
Stop it, Andreas.
Cough-cough.
Now, tell us about Joao.
I'm not lying.
The man you are looking for came here a while ago. So I told him about you.
What!
You stupid pig!
Maybe he's still around. Let's go look for him.
He's not here.
He's not here, either.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence.
Not here, either. Hmm, what's that noise?
You, hiding there, come on out!
Commodore, help me!
Emilio! What happened? Why are you all tied up?
Whew. Thank you.
Sorry, Commodore.
Who did it? Oh, you don't have to tell me, I know it was that wicked Joao.
Well, to be exact, it wasn't Joao, but his mate, Rocco.
I followed them to this building. But that old man blocked me.
He is a monster! I was powerless before him.
Yes, I've heard about him. That old man used to be called 'Monster Rocco'.
Why didn't you tell us earlier?
I didn't think he was that strong.
Get up. Where did Joao go?
He said he'll be at the harbor.
No Joao here.
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. Forget going in there.
Has a fleet left recently?
Yes, Commodore Joao's fleet just left.
Oh, no! We just missed them!
Did they say anything?
Well no, but they seemed to be laughing pretty hard about something.
They won't get away with this!
Commodore, this is the Franco residence. I have to admit, it is a nice house. But it's no place for us!
Hi $n, I was looking for you.
Oh, it's you.
So, Joao was in that port just as I said, wasn't he?
But things didn't go very well there.
Well, I just told you to go there. I never told you to let him go, and get all tied up!
How dare you say that!
People loved the story how that old man tied you up like a bow!
Shut up, dog face. I'll teach you to make fun of me.
Whoa! Hold on a minute there.
I won't stop Andreas if you were only looking for us so you could tease us, you weasel-faced numskull.
Ouch! No! Ouch! It just slipped out of my lips! Ouch! The true reason is, ouch!, I've got some information for you.
Information? That must be about Joao.
Uuuhh... Let me go...
That's enough, Andreas. Stop it.
Gasp, gasp... I thought I'd never breathe again.
Tell us what you know.
I will, but on one condition.
Andreas, he's all yours. Have fun.
Oh, no. OK, I'll tell you. There is someone who knows where Joao's fleet is.
Who is it?
A Portuguese nobleman of high rank. But I'm not supposed to tell you his name.
That sounds suspicious. If he is a man of high rank, why can't he identify himself?
I haven't finished yet. That nobleman has a grudge against the Francos.
That's why he's been following Joao's activities.
If you wish, he can help you, he says.
Sounds too good to be true. It might be a scheme.
It isn't a scheme. But he has a request of you.
His son has a crush on a girl called Lucia in the Lisbon pub.
He wants to see her alone.
But because he's a nobleman, he can't see her in public.
So he wants you to take her to meet him at another port.
If you can do that, he'll let you know where Joao is.
Is that all? It's easy to kidnap a girl.
Not a kidnapping. We need to take her out secretly.
I'm not too keen on this scheme, but if we can find out where Joao is...
It's a great opportunity. You accept the deal, right?
OK, It's a deal. Where do we bring the girl?
There is a port called Ceuta, just south of Lisbon.
Bring her to the lodge there.
I'll report our deal to the nobleman. Good luck!
Any day now, Joao will be within our grasp.
It's not a bad deal. It's good to have support from someone.
Commodore, let's go get that girl at the pub.
So we need to find the girl in this pub.
There's a woman over there.
Would you like anything to drink?
She's beautiful, but not young.
No, not a old lady like her.
Who're you calling an old woman?
Oooops, she heard us.
Of course, everyone heard you, you loudmouth.
Old lady, my foot. Just get lost, children! You're not welcome here!
Blast! Let's get out of here.
We're not having much luck with this older generation. First Rocco, and now this!
Excuse me, are you Lucia?
No, Lucia is my daughter.
May I speak to Lucia?
Why yes. Actually, if you're a traveler, tell her some interesting stories. She'll be delighted.
Lucia! You have a customer. Lucia!
Yes, mother.
This lady wants to talk to you.
Are you a stowaway? Oh, I'm so envious. I'd love to travel, too.
Anyone can travel, if they have 2 things - a ship and plenty of courage.
But I have to work here.
That's true. Not to change the subject, but do you know a young noble who visits here from time to time?
Yes, he comes here incognito. He is always kind and sincere, and he's very handsome.
That man said he wants to meet with you, but he can't come here right now. He's asked me to bring you to visit him.
Really?!
Would you like to go? He's in a port called Ceuta, just to the south of Lisbon.
Ceuta... I heard it's beautiful.
What luck - taking a trip and seeing you-know-who! Please take me!
Then get ready, quickly. Where's a good place to meet?
OK, I'll be ready as soon as possible. Wait for me at the lodge in 2 hours.
Tell your mother so she won't be worried.
Alright.
-Closed Due To Remodeling-
Remodeling? We came here all the way. Should I set it on fire?
Don't be silly, Andreas. Commodore, let's come back here tomorrow.
Commodore, let's finish our work as soon as possible.
Commodore, we should send Lucia to Ceuta first.
Lucia, are you ready yet?
No, not yet. Give me a little more time.
Where is Lucia?
What, you again? Lucia went to the lodge.
Where's Lucia?
Lucia went to the lodge a long time ago.
It's almost time.
Yes.
I hope I didn't keep you waiting too long.
No, we just got here.
You're late!!
Sorry, I had some business to take care of.
No problem.
Let's go to my ship.
I'm so excited!
Commodore, how did it go?
Very well. She was thrilled. We'll meet her here in two hours.
Well, only one more hour now.
Yes.
You're late!!
Sorry, I don't know where the time went.
I thought you had left already for Ceuta.
I apologize. Let's go to my ship.
I'm so excited!
Commander, how did it go?
Very well. She was really excited. We're supposed to meet her at the lodge in two hours.
One more hour till she gets here.
Yes.
Commodore, it's time to meet Lucia.
That's right. Let's go to the lodge.
Commodore, we shouldn't keep her waiting.
Yes. Let's go to the lodge.
Commodore, Lucia must be upset, waiting for us for so long.
I'm afraid so.
Commodore, let's take Lucia to Ceuta right away.
Excuse me, but is a young Portuguese nobleman staying here?
Yes, he's waiting for you.
I also have a message for you from a man called Perot. He wants you to go to the pub after you bring Lucia to the lodge.
Thank you!
$n, thank you very much. I won't forget your kindness.
I have an appointment so I must leave now. Good luck!
Wow, is this Ceuta? It's a beautiful port.
Yes, it is.
Commodore, we should get going to the lodge.
If we wait too long, the nobleman might think we're not coming.
Commodore, she looked happy. Feels good when you do a good deed for someone.
And she was pretty. No wonder that nobleman likes her.
